title: Fresh boulder
summary: One sol later, no storm. A fresh boulder stopped below the wall, inside the runout band. Sortie from the rover to the boulder and back, with the band as a hazard.
source: Scripted science target; reach angle from Grindrod et al. 2021

trigger.note: One Mars sol after the solar event; the mission clock jumps forward.

variants.label: Boulder and back, band-avoiding weights
variants.note: Planner weights with the runout band active (rl/planner.build_cell_costs band_active=True).

variants.label: Boulder and back, standing weights
variants.note: Planner weights with the band at its standing (background) level.

params.label: Boulder site distance from the rover
params.source: Nearest walkable cell in the distal runout band (see data/scenario/mission.json)
